Sonic Lore +9: Passive: Your Sonic spells gain a 9% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Resonance +63: Passive: +63 Equipment bonus to Sonic Spell Power.
Sonic Resistance +15: Passive: +15 Enhancement bonus to your Sonic Resistance.
Mythic Trinket Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
